mainText: Who am I? Guess Premier League star No 77. Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser. Giant Dzeko shirt unveiled in Sarajevo to mark retirement. A giant Edin Dzeko shirt is unveiled in Sarajevo to mark the Bosnia striker's retirement from international football. Ranking the best British football exports this century. From David Beckham and Gareth Bale to Jude Bellingham and Harry Kane, who are the best British exports this century?

titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: No 10 insists RAF Fairford is safe after US withdraws bombers. US media reported a new threat led to the bombers being removed on Sunday, following an incident near the base last week. Andrew takes legal action over search warrants before his arrest. Mountbatten-Windsor's lawyers are challenging warrants used relating to his arrest in February on suspicion of misconduct in public office. Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests. Sánchez says Spain will head to the polls on 29 November after recent defeats on measures aimed at addressing the country's housing crisis. Watch: How the eviction of an elderly resident in Madrid led to a snap election. A series of measures to tackle the housing crisis were defeated in parliament on Friday
